titleInfo.title: Culture as given, culture as choice

abstract.#text: Explores how culture, humanity's defining adaptation, originated and its functions. Expands the understanding of inequality, science, culture, change and value systems.

mods.tableOfContents: Beginning with sex : why males exist and how women are unique -- The other double helix : from reflex to culture -- How your culture works on you : perception and behavior as cultural artifacts -- Getting a grip on culture : making the concept manageable -- In the beginning was the word : language -- All in the family : relations, generations and obligations -- The shaft, and how you got it : inequality -- If it works, it's obsolete : technology and culture change -- The unquenchable thirst : knowing -- Worth dying for : a reason to live : believing -- Futures and alternatives : cultural trends -- Prepping for the third millennium : improving you odds.

note.#text: Dirk Van der Elst, with Paul Bohannan.
